cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant women who underwent cesarean section for placenta previa and were subsequently diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: The incidence of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) was 1.4 per 1000 deliveries and 1.6% of total cesarean sections, with the majority of PAS cases having three or more previous LSCS.
mod_finding: Placenta accreta spectrum is becoming more common due to a rise in cesarean section rates, and decreasing primary cesarean sections is suggested to reduce the risk of PAS.
